summary.name: GuruTrans
summary.one_liner: A browser-based collection of text tools that translate Japanese and Greek text, rewrite English in Shakespearean or ornate styles, and encode or decode ASCII, binary, and Morse code.
use_cases: translate between Modern Greek and English
rewrite modern English in Shakespearean style
convert text to binary or ASCII codes
aid reading Old Norse or Old English text
summary.what_it_does: The page lists several browser-based text tools grouped into language translation, historical and style rewriting, and code/text converters. Language tools cover Japanese-to-English and Greek-English translation plus an Old Norse aid. Style tools include a Shakespearean translator, a fancy English translator, and an Old English translator. Converter tools encode text to and decode from ASCII, binary, and Morse code. Some conversions run in the browser, while some AI tools send the needed text to providers described in the Privacy Policy. The page advises checking important results against a reliable source or a qualified person.
notable: Mix of browser-side converters and AI-based translators
Historical-language aids for Old Norse and Old English
Encode and decode for ASCII, binary, and Morse code
caveats: Historical-language aids should be checked against reliable sources
Some AI tools send text to third-party providers per the Privacy Policy
Supported inputs and actions vary by tool
